parsedVerdict.reasoning: SettleClaim works as an application-layer use case. It loads the aggregate through a repository port and gets coverage terms through an application port (CoverageSource). The settlement and decline behaviour stays in the domain: claim.settle and claim.decline do that work. The use case then saves the result through the repository. It contains no persistence code, no transport or HTTP handling, no framework code and no presentation concerns. The branch that declines a claim when no coverage terms exist decides which domain operation to call. It hands the actual state change to the aggregate, so it counts as coordinating the use case, not as business logic placed in the wrong layer. Settlement amounts are calculated inside claim.settle, not in this file. Wrapping primitives in Money values and returning paid.cents just converts data at the use-case boundary.
